name: Regular home cleaning (category guide)
summary: Recurring condo/HDB cleaners vs end-of-lease deep cleans — helper rest-day cover, part-time cleaner contracts, and why deposit make-good invoices are a different vendor problem.
body: Weekly or fortnightly part-time cleaners are a labour-market product, not the same as end-of-lease professional/curtain packages written into many TAs. Agree scope in writing (hours, supplies, windows, fridge, ironing), access/security rules with the condo, and whether CPF/levy obligations apply if you cross into formal domestic-work arrangements — casual WhatsApp cleaners are a grey zone many expats underestimate. A live-in helper’s rest day is the classic gap that part-time cleaners fill; do not assume the helper’s job description includes spring-clean intensity. Keep receipts separate from lease-exit make-good quotes so landlords cannot conflate routine dust with reinstatement. Pair with the end-of-lease cleaning category guide when handover clauses appear, and with helper-agency guidance when you are choosing helper vs cleaner economics. This is a category guide, not a ranked maid-agency or cleaner app ranking.
